'''Coforge Limited''', formerly known as '''NIIT Technologies Limited''', is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[information technology]] company based in [[Noida]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], India.<ref>{{cite web |title=Coforge, Persistent outperform mid-tier peers amid slowdown |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/coforge-persistent-outperform-mid-tier-peers-amid-slowdown/articleshow/128133434.cms |website=The Times of India |date=10 February 2026}}</ref> The company provides digital transformation, consulting, and IT services to industries such as banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), travel and transportation, healthcare, manufacturing, and government.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Dann |first1=Hansa Iyengar, Rohan Kulkarni, Melissa Fersht, Jason |title=Coforge drives impactful transformations with focused execution intensity |url=https://www.hfsresearch.com/research/coforge-impactful-transformations/ |website=HFS Research |date=1 July 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Analytics India Magazine |url=https://analyticsindiamag.com/it-services/how-coforge-is-building-its-healthcare-muscle |website=analyticsindiamag.com |language=en}}</ref>

The company's stock trades on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] under the [[ticker symbol]] COFORGE.<ref>{{cite web |title=Coforge Limited |url=https://www1.nseindia.com/live_market/dynaContent/live_watch/get_quote/GetQuote.jsp?symbol=COFORGE |publisher=NSEIndia }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=COFORGE Ltd. BSE India |url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/coforge-ltd/coforge/532541/ |publisher=BSEIndia}}</ref><ref name='FE'>{{cite news |title=Coforge Ltd Stock Price - (2369.60), Coforge Ltd Share Price Live Today, Coforge LtdStock Live BSE/NSE Share Price |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/market/stock-market/niit-technologies-ltd-stock-price/ |work=Financialexpress.com}}</ref>

==History==
The company was incorporated in 1992 as '''NIIT Technologies Ltd''', the software services division of [[NIIT]].<ref name='FE'/><ref>{{cite news |title=The Men Behind NIIT |url=https://www.dqindia.com/the-men-behind-niit/ |access-date=24 March 2023 |work=DATAQUEST |date=24 October 2002}}</ref>

In 2006, the company acquired UK Insurance Solutions Company. In the same year company partnered with [[The Adecco Group|Adecco SA]].<ref>{{cite news |title=NIIT partners with Adecco to provide enhance services |url=https://www.moneylife.in/article/niit-partners-with-adecco-to-provide-enhance-services/5527.html |work=Moneylife NEWS}}</ref> In 2008, the company signed a multi-million-pounds deal with [[British Airways]].<ref>{{cite news |title=NIIT Tech signs 3-yr multi-mn pound deal with British Airways |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/5Nh6yDb5khXsMm2gU9hbxM/NIIT-Tech-signs-3yr-multimn-pound-deal-with-British-Airway.html |work=mint |date=26 September 2008 |language=en}}</ref>

In 2012, the company implemented "Intranet Prahari" project for [[Border Security Force]] approved by the [[Government of India]].<ref>{{cite web |title=NIIT Tech - 'Intranet Prahari' project for Border Security Force launched by Hon'ble Union Home Minister |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/stocks/stock_market/corp_notices.php?autono=511225&classic=true |website=Moneycontrol.com}}</ref> In the same year, Indian Tobacco Board awarded a contract to the company for the implementation of [[e-auction]] system in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.<ref>{{cite news |title=NIIT Technologies in pact with India Tobacco Board |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2012/aug/02/niit-technologies-in-pact-with-india-tobacco-board-392933.html |work=The New Indian Express}}</ref>

In September 2012, the company launched Crew Wings, an application for Airline Cabin Crew Members.<ref>{{cite web |title=NIIT Technologies Launches Crew Wings, For Airline Cabin Crew Members |url=https://www.firstpost.com/business/niit-technologies-launches-crew-wings-for-airline-cabin-crew-members-1890333.html |website=Firstpost |date=5 September 2012}}</ref> In the same year, the company acquired [[Sabre Corporation|Sabre Holdings]]' Philippines Development Center.<ref>{{cite news |title=NIIT Technologies acquires Sabre's Philippines Development Center |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/software/niit-technologies-acquires-sabres-philippines-development-center/articleshow/16350119.cms |work=The Economic Times}}</ref>

In 2018, the Company acquired controlling interest in RuleTek, a US-based BPM architecture services company. After the acquisition, Coforge's digital arm Incessant Technologies controls 55% of Ruletek.<ref>{{cite web |title=NIIT Tech's arm to acquire 55% interest in US firm RuleTek |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/NMF2OkM9NkxQZGPOAxaQBO/NIIT-Techs-arm-to-acquire-55-interest-in-US-firm-RuleTek.html |website=mint |language=en |date=2017-05-31}}</ref>

In April 2019, [[Baring Private Equity Asia]] acquired a 30.6% stake in NIIT Technologies from the [[corporate promoter|promoter group]] for {{INR}}2,627 crore.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Pandey |first1=Piyush |title=Baring Private Equity to acquire 30% stake in NIIT Technologies for ₹2627 crore |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/baring-private-equity-to-acquire-30-stake-in-niit-technologies-for-2627-crore/article26760837.ece |access-date=24 March 2023 |work=The Hindu |date=7 April 2019 |language=en-IN}}</ref> In July 2019, Baring increased its shareholding by 35% via an [[Tender offer|open offer]] to public shareholders for {{INR}}3,045 crore.<ref>{{cite news |title=Baring PE Asia ups open offer size for NIIT Technologies |url=https://www.vccircle.com/baring-pe-asia-ups-open-offer-size-for-niit-technologies |access-date=24 March 2023 |work=VCCircle}}</ref>

In 2020, NIIT Technologies was re-branded as Coforge.<ref name='ET'/><ref>{{cite news |title=New strategy under a new brand? {{!}} CEO Sudhir Singh of Coforge to ET Now |url=https://www.timesnownews.com/videos/et-now/exclusive/new-strategy-under-a-new-brand-ceo-sudhir-singh-of-coforge-to-et-now/73951 |work=Timesnownews.com |language=en}}</ref>

In April 2021, Coforge acquired 60% stake in SLK Global Solutions for {{INR}}918 crore. After this acquisition, the company's employee count rose to 21,000 having inherited SLK's employee strength of 10,000.<ref name='ET1'>{{cite news |title=Coforge to acquire 60% of SLK Global Solutions for Rs 918 crore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/information-tech/coforge-acquires-majority-stake-in-slk-global-for-rs-918-crore/articleshow/82031106.cms |website=The Economic Times|date=12 April 2021 }}</ref>

By August 2023, Baring Private Equity Asia divested its entire 70% stake in Coforge, selling it across multiple tranches beginning in October 2020.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Ramarathinam |first1=Ashwin |title=Baring PE Asia sells 5.12% stake in Coforge for Rs1,008 crore |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/baring-pe-asia-sells-5-12-stake-in-coforge-for-rs1-008-crore-11621440070783.html |access-date=30 January 2024 |work=mint |date=19 May 2021 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Baring PE sells its entire stake in Coforge |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/baring-pe-sells-its-entire-stake-in-coforge/articleshow/103038069.cms |access-date=30 January 2024 |work=The Economic Times |date=25 August 2023}}</ref>

Coforge Limited, formerly known as NIIT Technologies Limited, is an Indian multinational information technology company based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. The company provides digital transformation, consulting, and IT services to industries such as banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), travel and transportation, healthcare, manufacturing, and government.
The company's stock trades on the Bombay Stock Exchange and on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker symbol COFORGE.
